When correct polarity (input = +24V):

- Vgs = Vg - Vs = 0 - 0 = 0. MOSFET off.
- No current flows. Output stays at 0. BAD!

When reverse polarity (input = -24V):
- Body diode: anode at source (0), cathode at drain (-24V). Anode > cathode. Forward biased! Current flows from source to drain, i.e., from output to input. BAD!
